text:
incident-bot: PAGER: P1 - Elevated 5xx rate observed from api-gateway (ingress). Alerting started ~1710501000. Initial symptom: surge of 503 and timeouts from edge -> customer-facing errors. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Correlation IDs available (see replies). Paging @anna-oncall, @devon, @maya, @li :rotating_light:

anna-oncall: On it. grabbing a bridge and logs. taking pager. brief: any known deploys in last 30m?

devon: No infra deploys in last 40m according to deploy-bot. Saw a small spike in upstream 429s ~5m before the 503s. Suspect upstream rate-limiter or a traffic burst.

maya: I'm seeing errors from the gateway converting upstream 429 -> 503 for some flows. working on collecting traces.

li: Quick check: metric spike from upstream CPUs? not yet, looks like tail latency + 429s from model pool. pulling kv logs now.

ops-bot: Customer impact estimate: ~1.2k failed requests in 8m window, 4 customers with >10% error rate (IDs masked).

anna-oncall: ok. devon, can you paste an example trace/correlation id so we can follow?

devon: here's a sample 503 entry from gateway logs (sanitized):

```
time=2026-03-14T18:05:12Z level=error service=gateway request_id=rid-8f3a2c trace_id=trace-1a2b3 upstream_status=429 converted_status=503 route=/v1/generate backend=runtime-pool-a msg="upstream returned 429: rate limit"
```

devon: grep command I used: `kubectl logs -n runtime gateway-abc --since=15m | grep "converted_status=503" | head -n 50`

maya: I pulled a matching trace in our tracing UI: `trace-1a2b3` shows repeated retries from gateway to the same backend which then returns 429s. Looks like retry amplification -> gateway giving up and surfaces 503.

li: Hypothesis 1: downstream model-serving pool hit an internal rate limit and started returning 429s; gateway retries amplified load and caused 503s. Hypothesis 2: a sudden traffic skew (one customer or batch job) triggered the upstream protective limit.

anna-oncall: mitigation plan options: 1) short-term: reduce gateway retry attempts for affected routes, enable route fallback to runtime-pool-b (older replica), or temporarily throttle heavy callers. 2) medium: scale runtime pool + throttle offending client. 3) long: adjust upstream rate-limiter and retry policy.

devon: I can toggle route fallback to pool-b and reduce retries. Would prefer test on /v1/generate first.

maya: +1. Can we also add a 1s token-bucket at gateway for the top noisy IPs? That might stop amplification.

anna-oncall: devon please run single-route fallback, and post commands you run. i'll notify support to message impacted customers.

devon: running `redwood route fallback --from runtime-pool-a --to runtime-pool-b --route /v1/generate --dry-run` then apply.

(devon posts after a minute)
devon: applied fallback for /v1/generate -> runtime-pool-b. also set gateway retry_count=1 for that route. Monitoring now.

ops-bot: Observability update: error rate for /v1/generate dropped from 18% -> 4% in 90s after fallback. Token failures upstream decreased.

li: good signal. still seeing some 503s for /v1/chat though. might need to expand fallback.

anna-oncall: scaling runtime-pool-a by +2 replicas as precaution. devon, can you also surface sample request_ids (10) for RCA? ops-bot if you can add those to the incident timeline.

devon: sample request_ids: rid-8f3a2c, rid-8f3a7d, rid-8f4b12, rid-8f5c33, rid-8f6d44, rid-8f7e55, rid-8f8f66, rid-8f9g77, rid-8fah88, rid-8fbi99

maya: copying trace ids to the incident board. Also saving a snippet of the upstream response pattern:

```
# upstream logs (model-serving)
2026-03-14T18:04:58Z pool=runtime-a request_id=rid-8f3a2c status=429 reason="rate_limited" capacity=0.0
2026-03-14T18:05:01Z pool=runtime-a request_id=rid-8f3a7d status=429 reason="burst_protection" capacity=0.0
```

li: timeline so far (rough):
- 18:02:00Z traffic spike begins (small subset of callers)
- 18:04:50Z upstream starts returning 429s
- 18:05:10Z gateway converts some to 503 after retries (first user-facing errors)
- 18:06:30Z fallback to runtime-pool-b + retry reduction applied
- 18:08:00Z error rate largely reduced for /v1/generate

anna-oncall: customer comms: support please reach out to 4 customers with high error rates and give ETA 1h and mitigation summary.

ops-bot: Support notified, template sent.

devon: expanding fallback to /v1/chat now. applying `redwood route fallback --route /v1/chat --to runtime-pool-b`

(devon) applied, monitoring.

ops-bot: Metrics: overall platform 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 3% in 5m after both fallbacks. CPU on runtime-pool-a trending back to normal.

li: For RCA we should collect: full KV logs for the 10 request_ids, upstream rate-limiter config snapshot, retry policy (pre-change), and the customer traffic pattern (IP/keys) that triggered the spike.

maya: I'll take ownership of trace aggregation and correlation id mapping. devon can you gather gateway config and the `retry_count` diff? anna can you write the initial incident timeline in ops/incident board?

anna-oncall: Assigned. I'll start the postmortem doc and include timeline + mitigations. tagging this as "in-incident RCA" for now.

devon: quick note — found a scheduled batch job from a partner that had a misconfigured exponential backoff and retried aggressively at 18:01Z. I've asked partner to pause. This matches the traffic spike.

li: that explains sudden burst. add to hypothesis: noisy partner caused amplified retries -> upstream 429s -> gateway 503 conversion.

anna-oncall: Next actions before handoff in 30m:
- devon: paste KV logs + gateway config diff into the thread
- maya: aggregate traces + attach to incident board
- li: snapshot upstream rate-limit settings and pool metrics
- ops: customer outreach updates

anna-oncall: handing to @maya in 30m for follow-up RCA. if anything regresses ping @anna-oncall immediately.

maya: taking post-incident ownership. will finish RCA draft and remediation plan (rate-limit per-client improvements, adaptive retry caps, better loud-client detection).

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Escalation: none. Closing pager once RCA draft posted.

anna-oncall: thanks team. saved logs and timeline to /incidents/1710501123/gw-503-upstream-rate-limit for postmortem.

maya: posted initial RCA draft and attached traces + commands. marking action items for follow-up.

ops-bot: Final customer impact note for handoff: ~1.2k failed requests, 4 customers impacted >10%, no billing changes.

maya: closing handoff — I'll update when RCA finalized.

devon: one more: add recommended change to default retry policy: set `gateway.retry.max_attempts` to 1 for high-cost routes. will add PR.
